title: npm run preflight, the operator read-only check, opens and migrates the live database at import: it writes the schema version, can rewrite legacy trade rows and rename a state file in the current folder, and with a relative path from another folder it creates a new empty database there

evidence.note: documented as a check that does not start the bot
src/preflight imports getAntirugDryRunStarted and getStaleTradesQuery from ./utils/db, so loading it runs db.ts module code
DB_PATH falls back to cwd/data/bot.db; mkdir if missing; new Database(DB_PATH) creates the file if absent; journal_mode/synchronous/busy_timeout pragmas
migrateSchema() runs and writes user_version = 7 unconditionally
migrateJsonState reads cwd/.bot-state.json and renames it to .bak
normalizeLegacyMainnetRows runs UPDATE trades SET chain = eth WHERE chain = mainnet at import
FATAL results are also sent to Telegram (AUD-DB-010)

sibling_sites_checked: Import closures of every script at the base: deliberate-buy.ts imports src/bot (database, notifier and config, which is expected for a buy that records a trade); preflight.ts imports src/preflight (database and notifier); audit-honeypot-checker.ts imports src/chainRegistry (provider and config, no database); pause.ts, resume.ts, capture-launch.ts and deploy-honeypot-checker.ts import only src/utils/logger (pino to stdout) and, for capture-launch, src/utils/abis; telegram-login.ts, recover-sell-ladys.ts and check-mythril-report.ts import nothing from src/. So preflight is the only script presented as read-only that writes the live database. The import-time writes themselves are AUD-DB-006 (version downgrade, rail 22-09) and AUD-DB-007 (cwd path, rail 22-09); the test-side reach is AUD-RAIL-002.
severity_rationale: S3, misleading ops behaviour: the writes are idempotent at the current schema and the legacy-row update is a no-op once applied, so no trade data changes today; but the operator relies on preflight being read-only (it is the sanctioned cold-start check before the live re-entry), and from a different folder it silently creates and migrates a new empty database instead of checking the real one. The downgrade risk is AUD-DB-006.
recommendation: Phase 29 (or with the 22-09 database rails, re-audited in 22-29): give preflight a read-only database path (open the file read-only, refuse when it is missing, never migrate), or move the two queries it needs out of the import-time database module; document the remaining side effects in the runbook until then.
